claims.text: Yes. Either party may terminate for convenience under Section 14.2, but only after Contract Year 2, and only by giving written notice at least 60 calendar days before the termination takes effect.

citations.quote: Each Party may also terminate the Agreement for convenience after Contract Year 2 (as defined in Section 14.4) by providing written notice to the other Party at least sixty (60) calendar days prior to the effective date of such termination

claims.text: Contract Year 2 is defined as February 1, 2020 through January 31, 2021, so the convenience termination right becomes available after that period.
